tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
Timnath-heres (or Timnath-serah) = "portion of the sun" or "abundant portion"
a city given to Joshua as a inheritance in the mountains of Ephraim on the north of the hill of Gaash where he was buried
Also named: tim.nat se.rach (תִּמְנַת סֶ֫רַח "Timnath-serah" H8556B)

Timnath-serah (or Timnath-heres) = "portion of the sun" or "abundant portion"
a city given to Joshua as a inheritance in the mountains of Ephraim on the north of the hill of Gaash where he was buried
Another name of tim.nat che.res (תִּמְנַת חֶרֶס "Timnath-heres" H8556A)
